Subject: measure theory | ID: 1595

Statement

Step 3. Using the torsion-free regularization, we obtain \(P_{01300013}\) as a limit in the operator norm topology of the Hardy space.

Conclusion. By Steps 1-3, applying the exponential convergence theorem, we conclude the proof with \(C = C_01300011 \cdot C_01300012 \cdot C_01300013\).
